name: What is the difference between storm damage repair and a standard remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between storm damage repair and a standard remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Storm-damage restoration focuses on returning existing rooms to their pre-loss condition, while a remodel redesigns or upgrades finishes. Following severe storm damage, however, homeowners often choose to combine repairs with planned remodeling. If a storm compromises drywall, subfloors, or framing, addressing those repairs creates an ideal window to upgrade flooring, tile, or cabinetry. The tradeoff involves budget and insurance: insurance settlements strictly address restoring damaged materials, meaning any style upgrades, layout modifications, or premium materials must be funded separately as out-of-pocket home improvements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Storm repair restores damaged structures to pre-storm condition, whereas remodeling changes layout, fixtures, or finishes, though both can be done together.
